title: Add tagline beside logo in app header

requirements.text: In the app header in App.tsx, display the text 'Understand Virality Through Mathematics' directly beside the logo image (frontend/public/assets/generated/logo.png). The tagline should be placed to the right of the logo, styled to match the existing Gen Z dark aesthetic — use a gradient or light-colored font consistent with the current header typography, appropriate font size for mobile readability (e.g., text-sm to text-base), and ensure the logo + tagline are horizontally aligned and centered or left-aligned within the glassmorphism header.

quotes: Beside the logo write th line "Understand Virality Through Mathematic"

acceptanceCriteria: The text 'Understand Virality Through Mathematics' appears in the app header immediately to the right of the logo image.
The logo and tagline are horizontally aligned (vertically centered relative to each other).
The tagline text is styled consistently with the existing dark Gen Z aesthetic (gradient or light-colored font).
The layout remains clean and readable on mobile screen widths without overflow or wrapping issues.
The logo retains its current size (80–100px height) and styling — no visible white box background.

constraints: Do not alter the logo size or its existing styling.
Do not modify any files in frontend/src/hooks/ or frontend/src/components/ui.
Preserve the existing glassmorphism header background and overall layout structure.
nonGoals: Modifying any calculator or simulator functionality.
Redesigning the tab navigation or any other sections of the app.
